name: Cruzeiro 2003 (Vanderlei Luxemburgo)
scopeNote: Cruzeiro, calendar 2003: Campeonato Mineiro (unbeaten: 10 wins, 2 draws), Copa do Brasil, Brasileirão (first points-based, 100 pts, 102 goals, title clinched 2003-11-30 vs Paysandu, last match 2003-12-14 vs Bahia 7-0). Luxemburgo took over from Marco Aurélio in August 2002 (Itatiaia) and left in February 2004, so every 2003 match was under him; no other manager found. Start date 2003-01-26 is the opening of the 2003 Mineiro (search summary of Wikipedia), NOT a verified Cruzeiro first match; the exact date of Cruzeiro's first match was not found. End date 2003-12-14 is from Alex's account of the Bahia game. Sources call it a team that played 'futebol' with the ball and a 10 (Alex); no analysis found that names a formation. Lineups show 4-4-2 (Lance, Alex on the midfield line) and a 4-3-1-2 / diamond (Itatiaia title game, Alex behind two strikers); a claim that Luxemburgo used a 4-4-2 losango in 2003 appeared only in a search summary of a Lance article not mined, so it is unverified. Documentation is thin: no tier A tactical study, no source on marking, pressing mechanics or width was found. Manager spell for Luxemburgo: Aug 2002 (took over from Marco Aurélio) to Feb 2004 (day not verified); only 2003 is profiled. Gap pass: one extra search on width (full-backs/wings) found no usable source; width stays a gap. Marking and pressing mechanics also undocumented (pressing rests on one Lance retrospective line).
openQuestions: Shape varied by match: 4-4-2 flat-ish with Alex on the midfield line (Fluminense 5-2) vs Maldonado/Augusto Recife/Wendell with Alex behind Aristizábal and Márcio Nobre (Paysandu/title lineups). Claimed losango not verified.
Zonal vs man-marking: no source found; Maldonado described only as interceptor and tackler.
Lance claim of 'pressão alta e transições rápidas' is a 2025 retrospective paragraph, in tension with Alex's 'time com a bola' account; treat as retrospective.
Exact first match of Cruzeiro in 2003 not verified (Mineiro opened 2003-01-26).

Trivela's 2018 'Há 15 anos...' tactical piece and the Atlético-MG/Alex piece were not-accessible; the Lance Corinthians 'como deve jogar com Luxemburgo' article returned 404, so the 4-4-2 losango claim is open.
